summary: Notes that some module utilities moved to collections in Ansible 2.10, such as ismount.py to ansible.posix and known_hosts.py to community.general, with the full list in runtime.yml.
questions: Where did the known_hosts module_util go?
What happened to ismount.py in module_utils?

answer_card.title: Module utilities moved to collections
answer_card.answer_md:
In Ansible 2.10:
- `ismount.py` → `ansible.posix.plugins.module_utils.mount.py`
- `known_hosts.py` → `community.general.plugins.module_utils.known_hosts.py`

See `runtime.yml` for all migrated content.
